fields.description: Comma-separated ISO 4217 codes that may be fiscalised. ZIMRA rejects currencies it has not registered (RCPT010).
fields.label: Allowed Currencies

fields.description: Used for the part of an invoice that is not paid at the point of sale (on account).
fields.label: Money Type for Unpaid Balance
fields.options:
Cash
Card
MobileWallet
Coupon
Credit
BankTransfer
Other

fields.description: Used for the part of an invoice settled by allocated advance payments.
fields.label: Money Type for Advances
fields.options:
Cash
Card
MobileWallet
Coupon
Credit
BankTransfer
Other

fields.description: Maps each ERPNext Mode of Payment to a ZIMRA money type.
fields.label: Payment Mode Mapping

fields.description: Open a fiscal day on the first invoice when none is open. A day that reaches its maximum length is always followed by a new one, so sales never stop.
fields.label: Open Fiscal Day Automatically

fields.description: Optional: open the fiscal day proactively at this time.
fields.label: Open Day At

fields.description: Optional: request the fiscal day close daily at this time.
fields.label: Close Day At

fields.description: Request the close this many hours before ZIMRA's maximum fiscal day length is reached.
fields.label: Close Before Maximum (hours)

fields.description: ZIMRA recommends renewing a month before expiry (§4.3).
fields.label: Certificate Warning (days)

fields.description: When on, certificates inside the warning period are renewed automatically, well before they expire and any ZIMRA outage can matter. When off, managers are notified and renew from the device form.
fields.label: Renew Certificates Automatically
